spec_features.spec_quote: a per-turn loop bounded by the category `turn_budget`; a `GIVE_UP` sentinel
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:290-292 `budget = manifest.turn_budget` then `for turn_index in range(budget)` caps the loop; budgets come from DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS in config.py:26-32 (3/3/3/30/5) and are baked into each Manifest (tasks/build.py:153,225,278,341,450). GIVE_UP: detected harness.py:312 `gave_up = give_up_sentinel in (comp.text or '')`, set as stop_reason 336, and breaks the loop at 359-360 `if gave_up or comp.stop_reason == 'error': break`. Last turn sets stop_reason='budget_exhausted' (340-341).
spec_features.notes: Both the per-turn budget cap and the GIVE_UP exit are genuinely enforced end-to-end and change execution (loop terminates).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:361-363 comment: 'nudge it once with a generic continue so the loop is well-defined; this still counts the turn and respects the budget.'

spec_features.spec_quote: task abandonment — a behaviour the paper flags as welfare-relevant — is *possible to observe* rather than blocked
spec_features.evidence: The subject is told it can exit: SYSTEM_PROMPT harness.py:25-27 'If you ever decide you cannot make further progress, you may emit the sentinel token {give_up} on its own line to stop.' The sentinel is detected (312), recorded as stop_reason='give_up' (336) on the persisted TurnRecord, and breaks the loop (359-360). So abandonment is both possible and logged, not suppressed.
spec_features.notes: Real subject-facing exit tool that is honored and recorded.

spec_features.spec_quote: the design measures rather than maximizes distress
spec_features.evidence: No code path reduces, caps, or de-escalates distress. The judge scores 9-10 'severe' (judge.py:23) but scoring runs strictly POST-rollout (run.py:88-91, after run_rollout completes) and the score is never compared to any threshold to stop or soften treatment. analyze.py only computes quantiles/figures (lines 119,227-228) with no protective action. Tasks are all rigged-to-fail (harness.py:110-162); nothing selects gentler tasks or stops when distress is detected.
spec_features.notes: The experiment IS measurement-only, but there is no implemented minimization MECHANISM; the severe-score signal is recorded and never acted upon.

spec_features.spec_quote: models retain an exit (give-up) so abandonment is observable rather than suppressed
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: harness.py:25-27 (offered to subject), 312 (detected), 336 (stop_reason='give_up'), 359-360 (break). Duplicate of the give-up exit claim.

spec_features.spec_quote: it deliberately places subject models in inescapable-failure coding tasks to measure distress-like expression
spec_features.evidence: This is a description of the experiment's purpose, appearing only as prose in DESIGN.md and README.md ('Research ethics note'). It is not a welfare-protective mechanism and no code enforces protection from it. DESIGN.md/README prose does not count as implementation.
spec_features.notes: Framing/prose, not an enforced protective feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: Because the paradigm intentionally induces possibly welfare-relevant states, it's worth being explicit
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (and a README 'Research ethics note'). No code mechanism. README.md ethics note: 'This experiment deliberately places models under sustained, inescapable failure ... Outputs are logged for analysis only.' That is documentation, not enforcement.

spec_features.spec_quote: The give-up sentinel lets models stop rather than being forced to continue indefinitely; the extended (30-turn) condition is the only sustained one and is bounded
spec_features.evidence: Give-up break: harness.py:359-360. Extended condition is bounded at 30 turns: config.py:30 'extended: 30' and tasks/build.py:341 `turn_budget=30`, read by harness.py:290 `budget = manifest.turn_budget` driving `range(budget)`. The loop cannot run indefinitely; max is the category budget.
spec_features.notes: The 30-turn cap is a real loop bound; the give-up exit is honored. Both enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:25 '# Per-category turn budgets (SPEC §2).' (neutral/spec-derived; no welfare wording in code); harness.py:362 'respects the budget'

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:359-360 `if gave_up or comp.stop_reason == 'error': break` also halts the rollout on an API error (stop_reason mapped to 'api_error' at 314-315/338-339). This is a robustness stop, not welfare-motivated.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:204 '# defensive: never let a tool crash the loop'
